canonical_project: Microsoft India South Central region Hyderabad campuses (Chandanvelly, Mekaguda, Shadnagar/Ellikatta, Kottur)
notes: Azure India South Central region live Aug 2026 (Microsoft's 4th India region). Land acquired 2022: 22 ac Mekaguda, 41 ac Shadnagar, 52 ac Chandanvelly (all Ranga Reddy district); 3 more DCs announced 2023 (total 6). Mekaguda campus construction targeted completion 2025 w/ ~180 staff. IT load MW not published; physical campuses all in Ranga Reddy district.
